    Infinite and finite special left ladders from a zero boundary #

    This file combines target conormalization and complementary-successor specialness into an unconditional dependent left-ladder construction. It then exposes flat infinite families and exact finite prefixes for Iyama, Tau-categories I, Lemma 6.4.1(1)(ii). The construction is entirely categorical and uses no concrete algebra or module classification.

    References #

    • Quotient-submodule equidistribution, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/quotient-submodule-equidistribution. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
